messages:
maria: FYI new hire's onboarding sample crashes on Cloudflare Workers when importing @redwood-inference/js. I'll paste the error and repo link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/tree/main/worker-basic

devon: What error do they hit?

maria: Runtime: Uncaught TypeError: default is not a constructor. They used:
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js'
new Redwood({ apiKey: ... })

aj: Sounds like our package exports resolve to CJS so the ESM worker loads the wrong artifact.

sophia: Confirmed in the published tarball: exports only pointed at a cjs file. Edge runtimes then try to call the CJS shape as a default export and blow up.

maria: This blocks first-run onboarding. Can we patch a point release?

devon: Proposal: switch to conditional exports mapping: ".": { "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/index.esm.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js" }, "./package.json": "./package.json". Also add an "./edge" subpath that points to a tiny ESM-only bundle.

aj: Add typesVersions fallback for older TS so editors resolve the d.ts. And ensure the ESM build exports a default for `import X from` interop.

sophia: If we ship an edge artifact, make sure build strips node-only deps and preserves identical auth/retry behavior. CI should bundle the sample with esbuild and run a worker smoke test.

ci-bot: buildkite: unit tests passed on main; no worker smoke tests currently configured.

maria: Please tag the onboarding doc owner when PR is open. This is blocking new hire flow.

devon: Opening PR with exports + typesVersions + a worker smoke test now. Will link shortly.

aj: Also add a small note in RELEASES.md describing the compatibility change so integrators aren't surprised.
